src: Ex 1.5 Study the cards and choose one for your creative writing
Card 1 – Letter from the Past
Task: Write a letter from someone who lived through the legend (150–200 words).
Start:
“To whoever finds this letter…”
Include:
Ancient prophecy
Haunting melody
Sacred ritual
Vanish into the mist
Style tip: Use at least one stylistic device (simile, personification, symbolism).
Ending:
“The truth will remain hidden until the ritual is complete.”
Tip: Describe feelings, fears, or wonders as if you really lived in the forest.
Card 2 – Monologue of the Spirit
Task: Write a dramatic speech as if you are the forest spirit.
Purpose:
Warn travelers
Reveal the ancient prophecy
Describe the dark curse
Start:
“Foolish mortals, you enter the woods as if the trees are silent… but the forest comes alive with whispers.”
Style tip: Use personification to make the forest “speak” and feel alive.
Optional: Include a mystery or warning at the end.
Card 3 – Guidebook to the Forest
Task: Write a page for a fantasy travel guide.
Sections to include:
How to reach the hidden realm
Warnings for travelers – e.g., “Never ignore an ominous sign…”
Local beliefs – e.g., “The haunting melody is said to…”
Style tip: Use symbolism or personification to make the forest feel magical.

Comfort and relaxationHygge is also about wearing cozy clothes like sweaters, socks, or scarves. It is a time to slow down, rest, and feel calm.

src: Hi, it’s Raya! Today I want to tell you about 10 ways to make your home cozy.
First, you can make a small corner for reading. Put a comfortable chair or a sofa, some warm blankets, and good light. Keep books nearby. This is a nice place to relax.
Candles are also very good. They make your room warm and calm. You can light them in the evening. They give a cozy feeling for everyone.

The wood is nice and warm. You can use wooden tables, chairs, bowls, or decorations. Wood makes your home feel natural and cozy.
Bring some plants, flowers, or small pieces of nature inside. You can put pumpkins, pine cones, or leaves in your home. Nature makes the room fresh and cozy.
Keep books in your home. You can read them in your reading corner or look at them on the table. Books make your home interesting and relaxing.
Use cups, mugs, and plates that you like. Holding your favourite mug makes drinking tea or cocoa special and cozy.
Use soft blankets, cushions, or rugs. Different textures make your home comfortable.
Old furniture, small decorations, or antiques give a special feeling. They make your home unique and warm.
Finally, keep soft blankets and cushions everywhere. You can sit or lie down with them. This is one of the easiest ways to feel cozy.

What is your favorite comfort food? Everyone is different. Some people love sweet desserts, some love salty soups or creamy pasta.
Here are some tips for a cozy feeling:
Serve food hot. Hot soups make you feel warm inside. Try chicken soup or pumpkin soup on a cold night.
Cook foods from your childhood. Foods you ate as a child can make you feel happy and relaxed. Apple pie, mac and cheese, or mashed potatoes can bring back good memories.
Enjoy food with others. Comfort food is even better when you share it. Eat pizza with friends, or drink hot chocolate with family.

Chicken Noodle Soup – warm, salty, and simple.
Apple Pie – sweet and cozy.

Homemade Pizza – cheesy and fun to eat together.
